decisions.rule: Store daily same-wallet changes with the per-day included-exchange set and exclusion flags. Do not sum daily bars into a 7d/30d feature when daily cohort coverage differs; preserve the provider's fixed-window same-wallet totals separately.
Do not attribute an aggregate exchange balance change to a specific incident wallet without per-wallet daily history or direct transaction-level reconciliation.
Keep cold, hot, unclassified, wrapped backing, insurance and charity funds separate. Aggregate XRPSCAN-labelled balances are custody observations, not tradable float or customer withdrawals.
Use exchange HQ/registration region only as exchange-entity concentration. Never label it customer geography or capital origin.
SBI VC Trade is an exchange entity and is not Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC East Japan). No relationship is inferred from the shared SBI-like acronym.
The 2026-10-30 daily aggregate decline remains context-only until fixed-cohort and per-wallet event attribution are available and walk-forward validated.
